We need to generate test cases for getDClass() method. It simply returns DClass.IN. Need to cover branches - there are none. But we still need test cases: basic test that returns correct constant. Also maybe test that DClass.IN is expected value, and that method does not depend on state.

We need to organize test cases by function logically. Provide input [] because no parameters. Expected return value is DClass.IN (which is int constant). Need description.

Potentially also test that calling on different instances returns same value. Could also test that modifying any fields doesn't affect.

But we need to follow JSON format: array of groups. Each group has "group": "test name", "cases": [ ... ].

We'll create group "getDClass" with cases.

Case 1: default instance returns DClass.IN.

Case 2: after adding records (using addRecord) still returns DClass.IN (to show no side effects). But we don't have implementation of addRecord; but we can assume we can call it. However we don't know Record class. Safer to just test default.

Maybe also test that method is deterministic across multiple calls.

We'll produce JSON with three cases: default, multiple calls, after creating subclass (if any). But we can keep simple.

Provide expected value as integer constant; we need to reference DClass.IN. In test code, we would import DClass. But in description we can say expected 1 (assuming DClass.IN = 1). Actually DClass.IN is defined in org.xbill.DNS.DClass. Usually IN = 1. We'll set expected 1.

Thus JSON:

[
  {
    "group": "Zone.getDClass",
    "cases": [
      {
        "input": [],
        "expected": "1",
        "description": "Verify that a newly created Zone instance returns DClass.IN (value 1) from getDClass()."
      },
      {
        "input": [],
        "expected": "1",
        "description": "Call getDClass() twice on the same Zone instance and ensure both calls return the same constant 1."
      },
      {
        "input": [],
        "expected": "1",
        "description": "Create two separate Zone instances and verify each returns DClass.IN (1) independently."
      }
    ]
  }
]

Thus final.
